curated-boska-gf-red-hat-text: Carved stone with a scratched-glass edge, bookish and dramatic. Boska's stark stroke contrast leads, while Red Hat Text draws one traceable, curvy pen-like outline so the drama never runs off.
curated-dafont-pixel-operator-work-sans: Retro terminal energy, blocky and wholly unashamed. Pixel Operator's fixed-width, code-style blocks against Work Sans's sturdy, unthinned curves make a crisp split, handy for, say, settings toggles.
curated-gf-allura-gf-della-respira: Della Respira brings tall capitals and real editorial weight. Allura's smooth, huddled pen script supplies the sweetness, a loose fit for a cute bakery and a couple of lines.
curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-pre-gf-tsu: Handwriting with a lightly pressed brush feel. Edu VIC WA NT Hand Pre earns its place big and brief, while Tsukimi Rounded's parenthesis-round forms aren't built for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-jersey-10-charted-gf-noto-nas: Jersey 10 Charted comes out tight, bold and expressive. Noto Nastaliq Urdu stacks lines in a tight vertical rhythm with little ascender height, dignified yet happier with brief text than extended reading.
curated-gf-kapakana-gf-spectral-sc: Loose, graceful pen strokes that nearly merge. Kapakana is happiest with closed, low-set letters and Spectral SC with open, wide-mouthed rounds and sturdy hairlines, a pairing for brief stretches.
